review.rationale: Decision v0.2 is a new candidate, not a retry of v0.1. It preserves the v0.1 failure record, reuses the exact root-bound validator invocation, five target paths, validation contract, caps, and non-authorizations. The persistent in-memory capture contract is sound, requiring sanitized envelope and direct content binding before tool return, with no API key, authorization header, or raw prompt persistence. Execution is strictly gated on a qualifying v0.2 Decision review (APPROVE, confidence >=0.9, all booleans true, zero blockers/corrections) and remote verification. All non-authorizations remain complete, and authority boundaries are preserved.
